subject: Add --moduleapi option to better use runtest-moduleapi (#1007)
reason: The change only edits the project's own test harness: runtest-moduleapi and tests/test_helper.tcl gain a --moduleapi flag that globs unit/moduleapi/*.tcl instead of hardcoding the test list. No server, tool, or module code changes; no runtime behaviour, reply, replication, persistence, or config path is affected, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could reach or break.
